messages.subject: Multiple reactive value assignments
parts:
I'd like the value of a ‘var’ to be set to “input$one” when “input$one” changes. At the same time, I want ‘var’ to be set to “input$two” when “input$two” changes. I’ve tried to implement it this way in server.R, but it doesn’t work. Can anyone suggest a better approach?

var <- reactive({ return(input$one) })

var <- reactive({ return(input$two) })

Jonathan

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Multiple reactive value assignments
parts:
I think you can use observe(), e.g.

observe({
var <- input$one
})
observe({
var <- input$two
})

Regards,
Yihui
